name: StreamFlix
overview: Netflix-style UI, server-verified Google Sign-In & Netflix profiles backed by real Jellyfin users
description: Transforms Jellyfin Web into StreamFlix: a Netflix-style cinema UI with an animated show/film mosaic gate, server-verified Google Sign-In (signed sessions), and Netflix 'Who's watching?' profiles mapped to real Jellyfin users with PIN and per-profile Google account locks.

versions.changelog: v0.5.1: stability & reliability hardening — thread-safe profile state synchronization across concurrent household requests, constant-time PIN verification with bounded brute-force lockout memory pruning, ETag-cached /Branding/Css responses (304 Not Modified), automatic Jellyfin 12 case-insensitive username sanitization for profiles with symbols/emojis, and branding.xml fallback tag insertion | v0.5: initial public beta release.
